name: Jims Vista Lounge
notes: Old-school Vista dive bar. Toast listing exists but hasOnlineOrderingModule:false, onlineOrderingEnabled:false and no menu data in the page state -- Toast used only as an info/directory page here, cuisineType 'Bar', description 'Come in and enjoy!'. jims-vista-lounge.res-menu.org returned 0 bytes (dead). Yelp 403'd. WebSearch summary mentioned a $7.50 beer pitcher and that tacos are served by a separate neighboring business (Taqueria Chabelita), not by Jim's itself -- consistent with a drink-only dive bar that does not publish a food menu of its own. Not found rather than blocked: no per-item priced menu exists on any reachable channel.

name: Coffee drop
notes: Wix site's /menu page renders an empty client-side shell with no embedded data (confirmed with a real browser render too, not just curl). The footer linked a single-page PDF menu ("The Coffee Drop Menu.pdf"); its text layer is empty so pdftotext returns nothing, but probe/extract_pdf_images.js pulled the embedded JPEG and it is a fully legible, complete one-page menu -- this is the whole printed menu, a small drink-only cafe. Address on the page footer matches the batch (2991 Broadway, San Diego). Hot/iced and small/large variants are listed as separate rows since the menu prints them as distinct prices; the two iced/size numbers are unlabeled on the menu itself so I called them small/large rather than guessing ounces. Rishi Teas lists one price (hot/iced $3) explicitly covering all 5 named flavors. Add-ons (double shot, simple syrup, stevia) are priced modifiers, included as their own rows since the menu prices them individually.

name: Conways Irish Pub
notes: No website. A dive bar/pub, tagged 'Divey' and 'Dive Bars' on Yelp with no Menu tab and no food mentioned anywhere in reviews or the owner's own business description ('Great friendly local pub where everyone is welcome'). Read the two dated Yelp photos tagged 'menu' (both blackboard drink boards, from the venue itself): a Drafts board (Guinness, Bright Cider, Mulligan, Boss Pour, etc. -- names, styles and ABV% only, no prices) and a Cans + Bottles board (Budweiser, Modelo, Corona, Stella Artois etc. -- names only, no prices). Facebook page (Price Range '$') has no visible menu content either. This is a drink-only dive bar that does not publish per-item prices anywhere -- genuinely not-found, not a limitation of the search.

name: Corner Grill
notes: Restaurant's own Wix site, Menu page is server-rendered with a full embedded JSON catalog (Wix Restaurants menu app) -- read directly, no browser needed. 8 sections: Entrées, Side Dishes & Extras, Salads, Specials, From our Deli Fridge, Family Meals, Drinks, Desserts -- a plausible complete Persian/Mediterranean grill menu (kabobs, sandwiches, stews, salads, family meal trays, deli dips, drinks, desserts). name: Mama Cella's
notes: Restaurant's own site (mamacellas.com/menu.aspx) lists full item descriptions for every section but publishes almost no prices (only three $2.00 add-on charges) -- confirmed by curl, not a rendering gap. Two aggregators (allmenus/Grubhub and BringMeThat) disagreed with each other by 10-25% on the same items in both directions, so per playbook section 6 neither was usable and tier-5 corroboration failed. Yelp's 24 tagged 'menu' photos turned out to span at least THREE different price eras of the same restaurant (e.g. Breaded Mushrooms priced $9.99/$9.31 on the low aggregators, ~$14.00 on one photographed menu, and dual dinner/a-la-carte pricing on two other photographed menus) -- used ONLY the highest-price, internally-consistent, laminated-menu set, one of whose photos is explicitly captioned by the uploader 'Updated August, 2025' (https://www.yelp.com/biz_photos/mama-cellas-san-diego-2?select=GEFTQQ7aPb5rpiIy5Ppf6Q), and the same design/table setting appears together with the Entrées/Kids/Sides page in a second wide shot, confirming they are one current menu book. Discarded two other older-looking photographed menus entirely rather than blend eras. Address matches batch (16707 Bernardo Center Dr). Covered: Appetizers, Soup and Salad, Subs, Entrées (pasta + parmesan + seafood), Specialty Pizza, Build Your Own Pizza, Kids Menu, Sides, Desserts. Excluded: a weekday lunch-specials sandwich board (a rotating discount on already-priced dishes, not a standing menu), a wine list (adjunct), and 'Chicken Wigs' mentioned on the official site but priced nowhere found. Held to medium confidence because the only priced source is a dine-in photograph rather than a live first-party menu, even though it is the strongest and most internally consistent one available.

name: Santorini Island Grill
notes: This UCSD Price Center vendor has no working first-party site: santoriniislandgrill.net (the domain UCSD's own dining page still links to) is now a hijacked generic recipe blog, and its old cached /ucsd-menu/ subpage lists item descriptions with zero prices. santorini-island-grill.res-menu.com returned 0 bytes. A Santorini on Uber Eats ('Santorini Island Grill - Scripps', 10545 Scripps Poway Pkwy) is a DIFFERENT branch entirely and was not used. Used Postmates (Uber-owned) as primary source and cross-checked against Yelp's menu tab (normally barred per playbook -- unblocked here because it agrees to the cent with the independently-owned Postmates listing across every one of ~25 overlapping items: Gyro Plate $8.79, Zorba Plate $9.29, Greek Salad $7.49, Santorini Salad $9.49, Super Gyro Salad $11.49, all Value Meals, all Rice Bowls, all Pita Sandwiches, Hummus & Pita $5.49, Falafel Balls $3.49, Pita Bread $1.79, all three Fries items -- matched exactly). Postmates lists the address as 9700 Gilman Dr and the batch lists 9500 Gilman Dr, Uc San Diego-Price Ctr E; treated as the same UCSD Price Center building (both La Jolla 92093, same restaurant name, same phone-area campus vendor, no evidence of two separate La Jolla Santorini locations) rather than a branch mismatch. The Breakfast section and its A la Carte sides are from Yelp only (Postmates' page was showing its Saturday all-day menu, not the weekday-only breakfast daypart, so there was nothing on Postmates to cross-check breakfast against) -- flagged lower confidence within notes for that section specifically, though the prices are internally consistent with the confirmed items. Two items mentioned in the old un-priced UCSD Menu page (chicken wings, a pita basket appetizer) do not appear on either current priced source and were not invented.
